chunks.text: AD3B Cryptosystem Comparison. An empirical comparison of AES, DES, 3DES, and Blowfish against NIST test vectors. Type: final-year. Stack: Python, PySide6, pycryptodome, matplotlib. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.

AD3B Cryptosystem Comparison problem: Comparing block ciphers fairly is hard: you need identical, controlled, repeated conditions and verification against known-good test vectors, not just self-consistency.

AD3B Cryptosystem Comparison solution: A comparison lab that implements AES, DES, 3DES, and Blowfish independently, verifies each against NIST and Schneier reference vectors, and measures them under identical conditions across performance and security metrics.

AD3B Cryptosystem Comparison proof: Ciphers verified against NIST and Schneier reference test vectors, not just round-trip self-consistency. 1600 of 1600 trials correct, all 16 build phases complete, frozen Chapter 4 results.
AutoEDA. Automated data cleaning and exploratory analysis, no code required. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
AutoEDA problem: Exploratory data analysis is repetitive: detect column types, handle missing values, remove duplicates, then chart everything. Non-programmers cannot do it at all.
AutoEDA solution: A web app that takes a CSV, auto-detects column types, cleans the data, and generates statistical summaries and visualizations, with no code required.

AutoEDA proof: Fed a 423-row messy CSV it had never seen (missing values, duplicates, an outlier). It auto-typed all 8 columns, removed the duplicates (423 to 421 rows), and generated a histogram, heatmap, boxplot, and barchart.
BemaHub. A gospel-creator platform with campaigns, a wallet ledger, and payments. Type: client. Stack: PHP, WordPress, MySQL, Paystack, PayPal, AWS S3, Next.js. Role: Backend Owner. Year: 2026.

BemaHub problem: BEMA needed a platform to support gospel music and Christian creators: campaigns with tiered access, a wallet and impact ledger, referrals, events, and payments, all governed by one set of business rules.
BemaHub solution: A WordPress plugin exposing a BMH REST API as the single source of truth for the business logic, with a companion payments plugin, and a Next.js frontend.
BemaHub proof: Live in production at app.bemahub.com. I own the backend; the platform runs real campaigns, a wallet ledger, and payments.
DH-RSA-AES Hybrid Cryptosystem. A hybrid secure-transmission suite with a performance dashboard. Type: final-year. Stack: Python, CustomTkinter, pycryptodome. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
DH-RSA-AES Hybrid Cryptosystem problem: Secure data transmission needs key exchange, confidentiality, and integrity together. A hybrid Diffie-Hellman, RSA, and AES scheme provides all three.

DH-RSA-AES Hybrid Cryptosystem solution: A desktop suite implementing DH key agreement, RSA, and AES for secure transmission, with a communication view, a performance dashboard, and a security-analysis tab.
DH-RSA-AES Hybrid Cryptosystem proof: Built with a sender/receiver communication flow, a performance dashboard, and a security-analysis tab.

ECC-RSA Hybrid Cryptosystem. A hybrid encryption suite with a live packet inspector and attack simulator. Type: final-year. Stack: Python, PySide6, cryptography, pycryptodome. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.

ECC-RSA Hybrid Cryptosystem problem: Symmetric ciphers are fast but need a shared key; asymmetric ciphers solve key exchange but are slow. A hybrid scheme combines them, and a teaching tool should make the whole exchange visible.

ECC-RSA Hybrid Cryptosystem solution: A desktop suite that performs an ECDH key agreement, AES payload encryption, and an RSA-2048 signature, with a packet inspector that shows the exact bytes transmitted, a benchmark tab, and an attack simulator.

ECC-RSA Hybrid Cryptosystem proof: Drove the real crypto flow: generated an ECC keypair plus RSA-2048, encrypted a message, and verified the signature and recovered the plaintext. A full hybrid round-trip, captured mid-flow with the packet inspector showing the bytes on the wire.

IASG Cooperative. A savings and loans platform serving five affiliated companies. Type: client. Stack: Django, DRF, PostgreSQL, Celery, Flutterwave, Resend, Cloudinary. Role: Backend Engineer. Year: 2026.

IASG Cooperative problem: Members across five affiliated companies needed a shared cooperative: savings, loan applications with guarantor sign-off, salary-deduction repayment, dividends, and statements, all with an admin portal to run it.
IASG Cooperative solution: A Django REST backend on serverless Postgres with Flutterwave payments, member and admin flows, PDF and CSV statements, and full OpenAPI docs. Deployed and live.
IASG Cooperative proof: Live in production with a public Swagger UI at /api/docs/.
Language Translation Tool. A multilingual translation platform with text-to-speech. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask, Google Translate API, gTTS, JavaScript. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
Language Translation Tool problem: People need quick translation across many languages with audio output.
Language Translation Tool solution: A translation platform supporting 100+ languages with automatic detection and text-to-speech.

LAUTECH Smart Assistant. An NLP FAQ chatbot for a university, with a JWT-secured admin dashboard. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask, scikit-learn, NLTK, PostgreSQL, JWT. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
LAUTECH Smart Assistant problem: Students ask the same admissions and campus questions repeatedly; a semantic FAQ bot answers them instantly.
LAUTECH Smart Assistant solution: A TF-IDF and cosine-similarity FAQ chatbot with fuzzy matching, confidence scoring, and a JWT-secured admin dashboard.
Movie & TV Explorer. A movie discovery platform with real-time search and an admin panel. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask, SQLite, TMDB API, JavaScript. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
Movie & TV Explorer problem: Discovering films and shows needs fast search and rich detail.
Movie & TV Explorer solution: A dynamic movie discovery app over the TMDB API, with trending, categories, detail pages, and an admin panel.
PDF to Audiobook Converter. Turns a PDF into an audiobook. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
PDF to Audiobook Converter problem: Reading long PDFs is slow; converting them to audio makes them consumable hands-free.
PDF to Audiobook Converter solution: A tool that extracts text from a PDF and generates spoken audio.

Flight Price Monitor. A microservice that fires an idempotent alert when a fare drops by 10 percent or more. Type: client. Stack: Python, Flask, APScheduler, SQLite. Role: Backend Engineer. Year: 2026.
Flight Price Monitor problem: Monitoring a booked fare and alerting on a meaningful drop sounds simple, but naive implementations fire duplicate alerts on every check. The alert must be idempotent.
Flight Price Monitor solution: A Flask microservice with scheduled price checks that triggers a single alert per qualifying drop (10 percent or more), with a full REST API and price history.

Flight Price Monitor proof: Created a flight, forced an 18 percent drop, and the alert fired at 10 percent. On a repeat call it returned alert_triggered false with the count still at 1. Idempotency confirmed.

SabreCWA Assessment Platform. A scalable test and evaluation system for a travel-technology company. Type: client. Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Alembic, JWT, Next.js, Tailwind. Role: Backend Engineer (team of 4). Year: 2026.

SabreCWA Assessment Platform problem: Sabre needed an in-house platform to author, deliver, and analyze assessments at scale, with strong controls: role-based access, anti-cheat, timed sittings, auto-grading, certificates, and reporting. Off-the-shelf tools did not fit the workflow or the control requirements.

SabreCWA Assessment Platform solution: A FastAPI backend on PostgreSQL with a Next.js admin, built by a team of four with Samuel owning the backend. Seven question types, three roles with impersonation, server-authoritative timers, anti-cheat, certificates, analytics, and CSV export.

SabreCWA Assessment Platform proof: Ran the full stack locally against a throwaway Postgres, seeded a demo admin plus a published test, and captured 7 authenticated admin pages (dashboard, tests, analytics, live monitor, results, certificates, settings).
SickleSense. A sickle cell early-warning system that predicts pain crises. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask, PostgreSQL, scikit-learn, JWT. Role: Backend Developer. Year: 2025.
SickleSense problem: Sickle cell pain crises can escalate quickly. Early warning, driven by daily symptom and hydration logging, gives patients and caregivers time to act.
SickleSense solution: A digital health platform with backend services for user management, health logging, early-warning logic, and machine-learning risk prediction.
SickleSense proof: Live deployed. Recognized by Futurize Founder Academy 2025 (Backend Developer, SickleSense Project).

Smart Travel Agent. An autonomous agent that searches flights, monitors prices, and answers document questions. Type: personal. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, LangChain, CrewAI, Groq. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
Smart Travel Agent problem: Flight search, price monitoring, and travel Q&A are separate chores. A single agent that plans, calls the right tool, and reasons about the result is far more useful.

Smart Travel Agent solution: A LangChain-driven agent behind a FastAPI backend and Streamlit UI, with flight search, booking history, background price monitoring, PDF question-answering over a vector store, and a multi-agent (CrewAI) mode.
Smart Travel Agent proof: Ran the agent for real: it called the flight-search tool, then reasoned about a mismatch in the tool's output and offered to retry. Genuine agentic tool-use plus validation.
Tic-Tac-Toe Arena. A tic-tac-toe game with an AI opponent. Type: personal. Stack: Python, Flask. Role: Solo Builder. Year: 2026.
Tic-Tac-Toe Arena problem: A classic game makes a clean showcase for game logic and an AI opponent.
Tic-Tac-Toe Arena solution: A tic-tac-toe web game with session state and an AI engine.

Sabre WhatsApp Helpdesk Bot. A production RAG assistant that answers Sabre-format questions over WhatsApp. Type: client. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Groq, pgvector, PostgreSQL, sentence-transformers, Redis. Role: Backend & AI Engineer. Year: 2026.
Sabre WhatsApp Helpdesk Bot problem: Travel agents constantly ask the same Sabre-format questions. Human support does not scale, and generic chatbots invent commands, which is dangerous in a GDS.

Sabre WhatsApp Helpdesk Bot solution: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation bot over WhatsApp: it retrieves from official Sabre documentation, answers with a grounded LLM response that cites its source, and hands off to a human when confidence is low.

Sabre WhatsApp Helpdesk Bot proof: Stood up pgvector in a throwaway container, ingested the Sabre guide, and drove the real pipeline: four format questions returned four grounded answers, each citing the exact source section.
Building a production RAG pipeline. What it actually takes to ship retrieval-augmented generation that does not hallucinate, from a real Sabre helpdesk bot.
Idempotent alerting, or why your price monitor spams you. A naive price monitor fires a duplicate alert on every check. Here is the small design that fixes it.
